_readme: Fictional example. Copy the whole private.example/ folder to private/ and replace every value; private/ is ignored by git. Every field is described in private.example/README.md.

board.title: Lindqvist Team Sheet
board.fill_context: The kids: Alva (handball at Northside HK F2016, swimming at Seals SK) and Theo (basketball at River Hoops U10). Messages may be in Swedish or English.

examples.yield_rule: r-seals-wed yieldsTo r-northside-wed = handball comes first on Wednesdays

prompt.kids_and_clubs:
KIDS AND CLUBS
- Alva (kid id "alva"): Northside HK F2016 handball (club id "northside"), Seals SK swimming ("seals"). School: Example School class 4A.
- Theo (kid id "theo"): River Hoops U10 basketball ("hoops"). School: Example School class 2B.
- The school is club id "school" (Example School).
- Use kid "both" for family-wide or unclear items.
prompt.club_messages:
HOW THESE CLUBS COMMUNICATE (important)
- Describe how each club sends its news: which system (SportAdmin, Svenskalag, Laget.se, …), the sender address, and whether every training gets a call-up or only matches do.
- Say which emails are the source of truth for the weekly trainings (the "routine" collection), e.g. a coach email listing season training times.
prompt.school:
SCHOOL
- Describe where school messages come from (sender address), how to tell which child a message is for (class names, year group), what should become events, breaks (days without school) and to-dos, and what to skip.
- Never write to the "timetable" collection. If an email permanently changes a class schedule, add a to-do "Update <kid>'s timetable: <what changed>" instead.
prompt.league:
NORTHSIDE HANDBALL LEAGUE (possible match days)
- Optional. Use this section if a child's team plays in a league with several club teams and the child's team for the day is only known from the call-up. Describe the league, the team names, the ids of the tentative events (e.g. ev-YYYYMMDD-northside-t1) and how a call-up confirms one of them. Otherwise replace this paragraph with "(no league section)".
prompt.gmail_query: (from:sportadmin.se OR from:svenskalag.se OR "Northside HK" OR "River Hoops" OR "Seals SK" OR "Example School")
prompt.mail_details: Describe how to read each club's call-ups: where the meeting time, place and reply deadline are, and which link is the reply link.
prompt.audit_kids: correct kid (Alva = Northside F2016, Seals SK, class 4A; Theo = River Hoops U10, class 2B)
prompt.audit_league: league call-ups confirming the right tentative match day
